title: SmtpRelayError Transient/Permanent wrap String — SMTP code not accessible to callers
description: SmtpRelayError::Transient(String) and Permanent(String) embed the SMTP response code inside a formatted string (e.g. 'permanent relay failure: 550 Relay access denied'). Callers who want to distinguish 550 (user unknown) from 551 (user relocated) must parse the string. A structured form Transient { code: u16, message: String } / Permanent { code: u16, message: String } would make the code directly accessible without string parsing. Currently is_transient() / is_permanent() are the only discriminators, which conflates all 4xx into one bucket and all 5xx into another.
